_help: Add or edit merch here. This file is the only place the store reads. For a live item set status to "available" and paste an https checkout URL (Stripe Payment Link, Shopify checkout, or similar) into checkoutUrl. Until that URL exists, keep status as "placeholder" and checkoutUrl as an empty string. The button will stay disabled and labeled as a placeholder. See README.md for step-by-step instructions.

products.name: Reach One Bracelet
